fields.title: Read percentiles
fields.inputs/0/label: Share of users experiencing latency above 2.8 s at least once
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: Add-to-cart screen: p50 = 90 ms, p95 = 400 ms, p99 = 2.8 s. A user adds 10 items per session, with 250 thousand sessions per day.
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/0: How many people per day will encounter a latency above 2.8 s at least once?
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/1: Is it worth setting a target for p99?
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/2: What does the gap between p95 and p99 indicate?
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: probability of encountering a slow request at least once in 10 attempts ≈ 1 − 0.99¹⁰ ≈ 9.6%, which is about 24 thousand people per day. Yes, a p99 target is needed: frequent action, the tail multiplies by the number of repetitions. A 7x gap between p95 and p99 indicates that some requests take a different path — likely a cache miss or an external call.
